screening_scope: Manual live-web sanity screen for currently visible search results using audiotactile, audio-tactile, auditory-tactile, and looming-sound PPS wording. The screen is used to catch newly indexed papers, current PDFs, and adjacent auditory-only or non-audiotactile PPS hits.

records.title: Audio-Tactile and Peripersonal Space Processing Around the Trunk in Human Parietal and Temporal Cortex: An Intracranial EEG Study
records.reason: Live web result is an already tracked audiotactile PPS task with iEEG context; the endpoint is context unless an event-trigger contract is required.

records.title: The Impact of Looming Sound Duration on Peripersonal Space Measurement
records.reason: Full PDF exposes the PPS-task parameters that were previously marked for extraction: 2 s and 3 s looming pink-noise tasks, seven tactile delays per duration, 16 repetitions per delay/condition, 21 auditory-only catch trials, 80 Hz 200 ms sawtooth tactile stimulation, response button, start distances, and 50 cm/s movement speed. Row-level tactile waveform/frequency synthesis is now runner-supported; the remaining issue is exact HRTF/right-lateral rendering provenance.

records.title: Multisensory integration in peripersonal space indexes consciousness states in sleep and disorders of consciousness
records.reason: Live web result confirms the already tracked task-free audiotactile near/far PPS EEG record; sleep and clinical endpoints are context, while near/far structure and any required trigger contract remain task-mechanics issues.

records.title: Semantic processing and individual suggestibility modulate motor preparation and perceived distance for looming sounds entering the peripersonal space
records.reason: The task uses looming sounds, motor preparation, distance estimates, and affective ratings, but no tactile stimulus or tactile response; it is adjacent auditory-only PPS, not an audiotactile PPS task profile.

records.title: Audiotactile interactions in front and rear space
records.reason: Occelli, Spence, and Zampini (2011) is a review of front/rear audiotactile interactions, not a distinct published experimental task profile to recreate.

records.title: Comparison of peripersonal space in front and rear spaces
records.reason: Live search result is the already tracked 2024 front/rear vibrotactile-plus-auditory-probe PPS task.

records.title: Enhanced audio-tactile multisensory interaction in a peripersonal task after echolocation
records.reason: Live search result is the existing Tonelli 2019 echolocation template/ledger record; it is now runnable as a virtual seven-distance lateral moving-source recreation, with exact speaker switching/gain, original noise asset, response timeout, and unfixed ITI retained as caveats.

records.title: Vestibular modulation of peripersonal space boundaries
records.reason: Live search result is the existing Pfeiffer 2018 vestibular/peri-head audio-tactile profile represented by the current lateral peri-head preload.
